title: House, techno, trance and big room: four-on-the-floor, rolling bass, plucks, supersaw chords, trance gate, arrangement maps
doc: F minor, 122-140 bpm, one cycle = one bar on 16 steps. Kick on every beat, open hat on every offbeat, clap on 2 and 4; rolling bass in the kick's gaps; plucks and supersaw chords on i - VI - III - VII; a trance gate is a 16-step struct with a short envelope on a sustained supersaw; arrangement maps are gate atoms on 8-bar sections and on a 160-bar club map of 32-bar blocks.

section.title: DnB, electro, house / techno / trance: kits, forms, feels
section.explain: Pack glyphcore/dnb-electro (docs/CONVENTIONS.md 8-11, sources in docs/DNB_ELECTRO_REFERENCES.md). F minor throughout, one cycle = one bar of 4/4 on 16 steps. Components are racks (band-scoped, docs/RACK_STANDARD.md; per-role classes reese, neuro, break, gate) and pattern atoms (dnb. drum-and-bass, el. electro, hs. house / techno / trance / big room, tn. tension and release); forms are gate atoms (dnb.intro .. dnb.outro on a 128-bar DnB form, el.* and hs.* on 8-bar sections, hs.map* on a 160-bar club map of 32-bar blocks); breaks are synthesised and chopped by re-sequencing the 16 slices of a bar (.bite(16, atoms.dnb.chops)); sidechain is first-class (kickPump moves the superdough duck onto the bass, chord and pad orbits; kickDuck wires a gain to kick:env). Seven feel templates (feel-liquid, -neuro, -jumpup, -electrohouse, -techno, -trance, -bigroom) fill the same slots as the phonk feels; their grooves are compositions of the standard presets (groove-swing | groove-push | groove-human with the voice seed).

atomsIngredient.title: House / techno / trance atoms
atomsIngredient.doc: glyphcore/dnb-electro house, techno, trance and big-room atoms (hs.): four-on-the-floor kick, offbeat open hat, 16th hats and accents, clap, rolling and offbeat bass, rumble, pluck arp, chords, trance gate, big-room lead motif; gates of the 56-bar house example (intro, groove, breakdown, build, drop, drop2, outro) and of a 160-bar club map in 32-bar blocks (mapIntro .. mapOutro, phrase8 ends). Import with atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/dnb-electro:atoms-house").

houseKick.doc: house / techno kick: sine at 55 Hz, 26-semitone knock, 0.28 s, light drive

bigKick.doc: big-room kick: deeper (50 Hz), longer knock and tail, more drive

houseClap.doc: house clap: band-passed noise at 1.5 kHz

offHat.doc: offbeat open hat: 0.12 s noise above 7.5 kHz

houseBass.doc: house / trance offbeat bass: saw, low-pass 450 Hz with a blip

rumble.doc: techno rumble: mono sine on the kick's off-16ths, slow 20 ms attack, low-passed at 160 Hz (the dry stand-in for a reverbed kick: reverb would put side energy under 120 Hz)

pluck.doc: trance pluck: saw, 3-octave filter envelope, 0.22 s decay

bigChords.doc: supersaw chords: unison 7, detune 0.3, spread 0.7, sustained

gatePad.doc: trance-gated supersaw: a 16-step struct (hs.gate) re-triggers the chord with a 90 ms decay and a short release, so the pad opens and closes on 16ths

roomLead.doc: big-room lead: three slightly detuned saws, bright, short sustain

rolling.body: ~ f1 f1 f1 ~ f1 f1 f1 ~ f1 f1 f1 ~ f1 f1 f2
rolling.doc: techno rolling bass: every 16th the kick leaves free

rumble.body: ~ f1 f1 f1 ~ f1 f1 f1 ~ f1 f1 f1 ~ f1 f1 f1
rumble.doc: rumble notes in the kick's gaps

arp.body: <[f4 c5 ab4 c5 f4 c5 ab4 c5 f4 c5 ab4 c5 f4 c5 ab4 c5] [f4 db5 ab4 db5 f4 db5 ab4 db5 f4 db5 ab4 db5 f4 db5 ab4 db5] [eb4 c5 ab4 c5 eb4 c5 ab4 c5 eb4 c5 ab4 c5 eb4 c5 ab4 c5] [eb4 bb4 g4 bb4 eb4 bb4 g4 bb4 eb4 bb4 g4 bb4 eb4 bb4 g4 bb4]>
arp.doc: trance pluck arp, 16ths, following the chords

chords.doc: chords, one per bar: Fm, Db, Ab, Eb (i - VI - III - VII)

gate.body: x ~ x x x ~ x x x ~ x x x ~ x x

lead.doc: big-room lead motif: short, repeated, one hook

intro.doc: intro (house groove): bars 1-8 (form: intro 8, groove 8, breakdown 8, build 8, drop 8, drop 2 8, outro 8 = 56 bars = 105 s at 128 bpm)

groove.doc: techno groove: bars 9-16 (rumble, rolling bass, 16th hats)

drop2.doc: big-room drop: bars 41-48 (stripped: kick, clap, lead)

vacuum.doc: the last half bar before the drop

mapIntro.doc: club map (160 bars, 32-bar blocks): intro, bars 1-32 (DJ mix-in)

mapDrop1.doc: club map: first drop / main groove, bars 33-64

phrase8.doc: the last bar of every 8-bar phrase (bars 8, 16, ... 160): turnarounds and fills

recipes.title: Four-on-the-floor house groove
recipes.intent: Kick on every beat, open hat on every offbeat, clap on 2 and 4, 16th closed hats with accents.

recipes.title: Offbeat open hat
recipes.intent: The open hat on every offbeat 8th: the house lift.

recipes.title: House shuffle
recipes.intent: The same groove with the house shuffle on the hats and clap: 16ths at 56 % swing (groove-swing(56)) and a small timing and velocity spread (groove-human(1, 0.1)).

recipes.title: Offbeat house bass
recipes.intent: Saw bass on the offbeat 8ths between the kicks.

recipes.title: Techno rolling bass
recipes.intent: Every 16th the kick leaves free, under a four-on-the-floor kick.

recipes.title: Techno rumble
recipes.intent: Mono sine rumble in the kick's gaps, slow attack, low-passed at 160 Hz.

recipes.title: Trance pluck arp
recipes.intent: Saw pluck with a 3-octave filter envelope on a 16th arp that follows Fm - Db - Ab - Eb, with a dotted-8th echo.

recipes.title: Supersaw chords
recipes.intent: Unison-7 supersaw chords, one per bar: i - VI - III - VII.

recipes.title: Trance gate
recipes.intent: A sustained supersaw chord opened and closed by a 16-step gate (struct + 90 ms decay): the gate is the rhythm.

recipes.title: Big-room drop
recipes.intent: Stripped: a big kick, a clap and one lead motif, the lead ducked by the kick (orbit 5).

recipes.title: Uplifting trance drop
recipes.intent: Four-on-the-floor, offbeat bass, gated supersaw chords and the pluck arp, all ducked by the kick on orbit 3.

syntax.title: Uplifting build on the shared grammar: roll, filter build, riser, gap, impact
syntax.code:
setcpm(138/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/dnb-electro:atoms-house")
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/edm:atoms-edm-core")
hooks.bind("rise", "noiseRiser(13.9)", atoms.ec.rise8({ at: "9b" })); hooks.bind("hit", "impactBoom", atoms.ec.hit({ at: "9b" }))
roll: s(atoms.ec.roll8).velocity(atoms.ec.rollVel8).hook("houseClap").tags("build")
chords: note(atoms.hs.chords).hook("bigChords | filterBuild").tags("build")
gate: note(atoms.hs.chords).hook("gatePad").tags("drop")
kick: s(atoms.hs.kick).hook("houseKick").tags("drop")
rise: s("x").use("rise", { else: "silence" })
hit: s("x").use("hit", { else: "silence" })
tagged("build").mute("@9b"); tagged("drop").mute("<9b")
tagged("build").mute("8.3b..9b")   // the gap: half a bar of nothing before the drop

syntax.title: Trance gate: a 16-step struct on a sustained supersaw
syntax.code:
setcpm(138/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/dnb-electro:atoms-house")
$: note(atoms.hs.chords).hook("gatePad")                         // the gate is inside the rack (struct hs.gate)
$: note(atoms.hs.chords).struct("x*16").hook("bigChords").decay(0.08).sustain(0).velocity(0.5)   // the same idea written out: every 16th

syntax.title: Club map: 32-bar blocks as gates
syntax.code:
setcpm(128/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/dnb-electro:atoms-house")
hooks.bind("kick", "houseKick"); hooks.bind("hat", "offHat"); hooks.bind("pad", "bigChords")
kick: s(atoms.hs.kick).use("kick").tags("drums")
hat: s(atoms.hs.offHat).use("hat").tags("drums")
pad: note(atoms.hs.chords).use("pad").tags("pad")
tagged("drums").mute(atoms.hs.mapBreak)          // breakdown 65-80: no drums
tagged("pad").mute(atoms.hs.mapIntro)            // the intro is DJ-friendly: drums only
tagged("drums").mute(atoms.hs.phrase8).mute("<0b")   // a turnaround idea: thin the last bar of each phrase (shown off here)
